row.notes: Finds the spline segment containing lap distance (xmm1): the last segment's +0xb0 is the lap length; closed loops (+0x88 set) wrap with fmod, open ones clamp to [0, length]; bucket = u16 table inline at +0x90 indexed by (int)(d * +0x8c); then walks the segment pointer vector +0x18..+0x20 until seg+0xb4 <= d <= seg+0xb0 (+0xb4 = segment start, +0xb0 = segment end; corrected per V3572/V4003), returns 0 past the end. 8 call sites (vehicle placement rulesets, formation-lap parking check). raised by engine-re with --force 2026-11-14 at user request (lane owner review requested)

verify.notes: V3572 fmod wrap when +0x88 set, u16 bucket table +0x90 scaled by +0x8c, walks segments from +0x18 vector all as claimed; but segment bounds are reversed: loop tests value < [seg+0xb4] || [seg+0xb0] < value so +0xb4 is the start and +0xb0 the end. Callers seen

V4003 fmod wrap when +0x88 set, u16 bucket table +0x90 scaled by +0x8c, walks segments from +0x18 vector all as claimed; but segment bounds are reversed: loop tests value < [seg+0xb4] || [seg+0xb0] < value so +0xb4 is the start and +0xb0 the end. Callers seen
V4094 bucket u16 table +0x90 scaled +0x8c, segments +0x18 (+0xb0/+0xb4), fmod wrap +0x88, 4 named callers confirmed

V10389 L2 check, blind re-derivation (own capstone disasm of work/exe/F1_25.exe, own rel32/riprel/abs64 scans over .xtls/.xtext/.data1). 8 rel32 callers by my scan. len = [[spline+0x20]-8]+0xb0; +0x88 set -> fmod (0x1453556a4) + len if negative, else clamp [0,len]; bucket u16 [spline + (int)(d*[+0x8c])*2 + 0x90]; walk [+0x18]..[+0x20] until seg+0xb4 <= d <= seg+0xb0; past end returns 0.
